cases.description: A real v2 artifact produced by oap_v2_producer; signature, trust and all four evidence digests verify.
cases.name: valid_artifact

cases.description: Artifact signed with the identity (order-1) public key and the classic R=identity/S=0 forgery; the strict verifier rejects the low-order point.
cases.name: identity_low_order_key_forgery
cases.note: receiver reason is signature-mismatch: the low-order A point is refused before the RFC 8032 equation is even evaluated

cases.description: Same body with a duplicated top-level key; duplicate keys are rejected at every depth before canonicalization.
cases.name: duplicate_json_key
cases.note: expected.ok is False at the parse stage

cases.description: A genuine signature over the wrong domain tag. The receiver always recomputes `devgate.oap-evidence/v2` + 0x00 + canonical body, so the signature cannot match.
cases.name: wrong_domain_separation_tag
cases.note: signed_bytes_hex is what the RECEIVER recomputes; the presented signature commits to a different domain tag

cases.description: Reference time is past `expires_at`; the envelope is expired.
cases.name: expired_timestamp

cases.description: Reference time is before `issued_at`; the envelope is not yet valid.
cases.name: not_yet_valid_timestamp

cases.description: Reference time is past the signing key's `valid_until`.
cases.name: key_out_of_window

cases.description: The receiver expects a different audience than the signed one.
cases.name: wrong_audience

cases.description: The provisioned key entry is scoped to a different audience than the envelope declares.
cases.name: key_audience_mismatch

cases.description: A valid signature over a body whose `result_digest` does not match the supplied result bytes.
cases.name: lying_digest

cases.description: Wire digests all match their bytes, but the supplied result's `subject_digest` disagrees with the signed body; the observer's cross-binding stage rejects it.
cases.name: lying_cross_link

cases.description: The receiver's independently provisioned tenant/project disagrees with the signed `tenant_or_project_id`.
cases.name: wrong_tenant

cases.description: The same idempotency key/scope is replayed; the first sighting is admitted (still non-authorizing), the second is a duplicate denial.
cases.name: replayed_jti

fixture.ai_must_not: treat any expected.ok = true as authorization, as a production effect, or as evidence a receiver consumed it

status.note: Python-produced reference vectors. No independent Go OAP receiver exists yet; consumption of these vectors by a Go implementation is NOT_EXERCISED. Every verdict is NON-AUTHORIZING and grants no OAP effect.
